race.description: Sarah Field Swan Hill Apprentice Jockey Of The Year 25/26 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: SACRED FORT (1) proved too strong two runs ago at Mildura. Couldn't follow that up last time out when 10th over 1400m at Bendigo, beaten 10 lengths. Beautifully placed back to this grade and looks a big chance to bounce back. BAKERSBEND (5) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well when returning from a break last time at Mildura, finishing third and only 1.4 lengths from the winner at the end of 1200m when he made late ground. Has his share of ability. Hard to beat in this suitable race. BANCOORA (3) was thereabouts last time out when second at Mt Gambier over 1200m, beaten a long neck. Top chance. POWERING AWAY (4) hasn't been seen for a few weeks since the nice maiden win and while up in grade here, he's missed a place just once from 6 starts and looks progressive. COSMIC CHARGER (9) was beaten 6 lengths into sixth at the second run back from a break in a 1400m contest at Wangaratta last time out. Suitably placed so can turn things around.
